_doc: Phase 08 stage runtime config. key = '<stageId>-<layer>' (matches BootScene load.image keys). scrollFactor + layer order per concepts/backgrounds/README.md. Depth bands: layers 0-2, props 3-8, fighters 9-11. ponytail: the 'near' front occluder (depth 20) is intentionally omitted from render -- its dark dusk-palette edge read as residual purple and its only job was a foreground strip; BootScene still preloads near.png so re-adding a '<stage>-near' entry here restores it. Layers are pre-baked 1697x720 by scripts/copy-stage-layers.py; renderer places them at setScale(1), origin (0,0). Props: atlasFrame is the twilight-atlas prefix ('<frame>-0..3'), x/y is the bottom-center anchor (setOrigin(0.5,1)) on the roof (feet line GROUND_Y=620).
